text:
samira: Deploy to prod finished for release v2-routing at 20:40 PT. Canary -> 100%. Starting quick post-release smoke: health, generate, embeddings. Please run quick checks and report within 15m. Ping @oncall for infra issues. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Deployment succeeded — canary -> 100% (3m). image: registry/redwood:v2-routing-20260317

matt: Got it. running /health and a couple of gen samples now.

li: Quick commands:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood-inference.prod/health
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.prod/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq .
```

anya: first 5m: embeddings p50 ~130ms (+8%), p99 ~560ms (+12%). throughput steady. no increased errors yet.

matt: I see a single 500 from eu-west-1 at 20:43, re-running sample against fallback. will post results.

sre-bot: Autoscaler status: healthy. No OOMs or node restarts in last 15m. Logs show model fallback at 20:43:12 for one request.

li: re-run load: `hey -n 50 -c 5 https://api.redwood-inference.prod/v1/embeddings` (will share exact output in 10m)

anya: traced 500 to model-variant mismatch on a small routing shard; toggling rollback policy to fallback-variant now.

matt: hotpatch prepared: small routing-rule fix. canaryed to 10% now — observing.

samira: Good. Rollback plan is ready (runbook: /runbooks/deploy/rollback). Keep updates here. If smoke looks green at +30m we'll close.

michael: Smoke pass at 20:55: health 200, sample gen ok, embeddings p50 120ms, p99 480ms, error rate <0.05%. No rollback.

samira: :thumbsup: Closing thread in 5m unless anyone objects.

matt: no objections. closing.
